ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.label: nascent god
ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.description: A young god, known only to a handful of believers. Its voice is faint, but it is heard.

ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.label: revered god
ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.description: A god whose name is spoken with reverence. It can now strike down the wicked and kindle genius in its faithful.

ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.label: mighty god
ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.description: A god of real power. Through its prophet it can bless the harvest, terrify armies and even return the faithful dead.

ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.label: exalted god
ImAGod.DivinityTierDef.description: A god at the height of its glory. It may now descend and walk among its people in the flesh of a chosen follower.
